# Add to Playlist

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Adds the provided music to the provided playlist.

## Syntax

~~~~text
addToPlaylist(music: <#Variable (Optional)#>, playlist: <#Playlist (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
addToPlaylist(music: ShortcutInput, playlist: My Music Library)
~~~~
